title: Waltair Veerayya
desc: Waltair Veerayya, a fisherman and smuggler, is in dire need of money in order to fight a court case. Later, he is approached by an officer to extradite Solomon Caesar, an infamous drug lord for money.

title: Baby & Baby
desc: Things take an unexpected turn when two couples, heading to their families' homes to introduce their babies, accidentally switch their infants.

title: Robinhood
desc: A modern-day Robin Hood thrives on stealing from the rich. However, he reluctantly becomes a bodyguard for a high-profile client due to unforeseen circumstances.

title: Godzilla x Kong: The New Empire
desc: Godzilla and Kong, two titans from the ancient world, join forces to face a colossal threat emerging from deep within the earth's core.

title: Baahubali: The Beginning
desc: Raised by a tribe, a young man sets out to help his lady love rescue an enslaved princess of a kingdom that is ruled by a tyrannical king. In doing so, he soon discovers his true identity.
